YMFC shines spotlight on boat dealer VForce Marine

The StaffSeptember 2, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:24
Instaread

As part of its Dealer Spotlight series, Yamaha Motor Finance Corp. recently highlighted the successes of VForce Marine, a boat dealership in Orlando, Florida.

Yamaha says it is recognizing VForce Marine for its work with Hubbs-SeaWorld Research Institute (HSWRI), a nonprofit scientific research organization focused on marine life conservation, ocean health, and animal rescue. VForce Marine is able to support Florida-area conservation efforts by providing vehicles used by HSWRI staff.

“Truly, one of the things I cherish most is being able to give back to the community, give back to the wildlife, and give back to this amazing ecosystem that we have,” says Dewayne Nighswonger, general manager of VForce Marine.

Watch the Dealer Spotlight of VForce Marine below

Beth Castle, VForce Marine’s general sales manager, adds that the dealership’s success with many of its clients is helped by its partnership with Yamaha Financial Services. When describing how Yamaha helps VForce’s customer experience, Castle explains, “We have all of the resources right there, ready to work and make that deal happen.”

The VForce Marine team says it is grateful for the strength of their partnership with Yamaha and looks to continue their successes long into the future. “We have truly assembled the best team in the business,” says Nighswonger. “Every team member plays a role in creating an exceptional customer experience, and our success would not be possible without their commitment and dedication.”
